title: Find the Derangement of An Array
goal: Count permutations in which no position keeps its original item.
strategy: Focus on the item paired with the first position. Either those two items swap as a pair or the displaced item participates in a larger cycle, giving D(n)=(n-1)*(D(n-1)+D(n-2)).
